en: Matthew 1

p.src: 1  The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

ja: ダビデの子、アブラハムの
であるイエス・キリストの
en: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
u.src: 1  The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

ja: 1:1 メシア（ヘブル語）とキリスト（ギリシャ語）は、どちらも「油を注がれた者」という意味である。
zh: 1:1 後裔，子孫：原文是兒子；下同
en: 1:1 Messiah (Hebrew) and Christ (Greek) both mean “Anointed One”

p.src: 2  Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.

ja: アブラハムにイサクが
まれ、イサクにヤコブが
まれ、ヤコブにユダとその
en: Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.
u.src: 2  Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.

p.src: 3  Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.

ja: ユダとタマルの間にペレツとゼラが
まれ、ペレツにヘツロンが
まれ、ヘツロンにラムが
en: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.
u.src: 3  Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.

p.src: 4  Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.

ja: まれ、アミナダブにナフションが
まれ、ナフションにサルモンが
en: Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.
u.src: 4  Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.

p.src: 5  Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.

ja: サルモンとラハブの間にボアズが
まれ、ボアズとルツの間にオベデが
まれ、オベデにエッサイが
en: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.
u.src: 5  Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.

p.src: 6  Jesse became the father of King David. David the king became the father of Solomon by her who had been Uriah’s wife.

en: Jesse became the father of King David. David the king became the father of Solomon by her who had been Uriah’s wife.
u.src: 6  Jesse became the father of King David. David the king became the father of Solomon by her who had been Uriah’s wife.

ja: 1:6 NU本文では「王」が省かれている。
en: 1:6 NU omits “the king”.

p.src: 7  Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.

ja: ソロモンにレハブアムが
まれ、レハブアムにアビヤが
en: Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.
u.src: 7  Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.

p.src: 8  Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.

ja: アサにヨシャファトが
まれ、ヨシャファトにヨラムが
まれ、ヨラムにウジヤが
en: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.
u.src: 8  Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.

p.src: 9  Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.

ja: ウジヤにヨタムが生まれ、ヨタムにアハズが生まれ、アハズにヒゼキヤが生まれた。
en: Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.
u.src: 9  Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.

p.src: 10  Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.

ja: ヒゼキヤにマナセが生まれ、マナセにアモンが生まれ、アモンにヨシヤが生まれた。
en: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.
u.src: 10  Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.

p.src: 11  Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.

ja: バビロン捕囚のころ、ヨシヤにエコニヤとその
en: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.
u.src: 11  Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.

p.src: 12  After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.

ja: 、エコニヤにシェアルティエルが生まれ、シェアルティエルにゼルバベルが生まれた。
en: After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.
u.src: 12  After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.

p.src: 13  Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.

ja: ゼルバベルにアビウドが生まれ、アビウドにエリアキムが生まれ、エリアキムにアゾルが生まれた。
en: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.
u.src: 13  Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.

p.src: 14  Azor became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.

ja: アゾルにツァドクが生まれ、ツァドクにアキムが生まれ、アキムにエリウドが生まれた。
en: Azor became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.
u.src: 14  Azor became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.

p.src: 15  Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.

ja: エリウドにエレアザルが生まれ、エレアザルにマタンが生まれ、マタンにヤコブが生まれた。
en: Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.
u.src: 15  Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.

p.src: 16  Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

ja: ヨセフが生まれた。このマリアから、キリストと
en: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
u.src: 16  Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

ja: 1:16 「イエス」は「救い」という意味である。
en: 1:16 “Jesus” means “Salvation”.

p.src: 17  So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.

ja: こうして、アブラハムからダビデまでが
、ダビデからバビロン捕囚までが
、バビロン捕囚からキリストまでが
en: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.
u.src: 17  So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.

p.src: 18  Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.

ja: さて、イエス・キリストの
en: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.
u.src: 18  Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.

p.src: 19  Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.

ja: にしたくなかったので、ひそかに
en: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.
u.src: 19  Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.

p.src: 20  But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, don’t be afraid to take to yourself Mary as your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

ja: れずにマリアを妻として
en: But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, don’t be afraid to take to yourself Mary as your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.
u.src: 20  But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, don’t be afraid to take to yourself Mary as your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

ja: 1:20 「見よ」はギリシャ語の「ἰδοὺ」に由来し、「見る、注意を向ける、観察する、目を留める」という意味で、しばしば間投詞として用いられる。
en: 1:20 “Behold”, from “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

p.src: 21  She shall give birth to a son. You shall name him Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”

ja: をイエスとつけなさい。この方こそ、ご
en: She shall give birth to a son. You shall name him Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”
u.src: 21  She shall give birth to a son. You shall name him Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”

ja: 1:21 「イエス」は「救い」という意味である。
en: 1:21 “Jesus” means “Salvation”.

en: Now all this has happened that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,

en: “Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel,” which is, being interpreted, “God with us.”

en: 1:23 Isaiah 7:14

en: Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife to himself;
u.src: 24  Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife to himself;

p.src: 25  and didn’t know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.

ja: たなかった。そして、その
en: and didn’t know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.
